pandas_contract.stream: one DataFrame per non-None input RecordBatch; no cross-batch materialization
pandas_contract.reconstruction: read parts in manifest order, concatenate without ignore_index, set index from __canonical_index__
pandas_contract.index_metadata: per part: original pandas index class/dtype/name and first/last label; explicit labels persisted
pandas_contract.combined_index_reconstruction: RangeIndex(0, rows) iff index_range_reconstructable is true; otherwise pandas Index of the explicit labels
pandas_contract.empty: zero-row RecordBatch parts preserve schema; if the input yields no batches, materialization requires an explicit zero-row canonical empty_template; absent template fails closed

publication_semantics: public only when this complete directory is visible at final_path after atomic rename
